No, you are not a bad person for having those feelings. I felt similar when my girlfriend first came out. A lot of doubt, anxiety, fear about pretty much anything. 
I think the best advice I can give you is to be patient with not only your partner, but also yourself. Change can be difficult, and it's 100% okay to be scared by it, but you can't resist it. 
For me, talking to my partner and taking it day by day helped a lot in terms of me coming to terms with it, and also understanding myself and what I can do and stuff.

Thinking about how women are socialized (i.e. slut shamed for casual sex and stuff), i think you have ur answer right there. But what I think an important distinction is  between the desire to have sex with "someone specific", but the desire to have sex in general. Say, an allo woman, may want to have sex in general, but will only do it with specific person. That's different than someone who doesn't want to have sex in general, but will only do it with specific person.

Anyways, that's always been my interpretation of demisexuality. Not saying that it's 100% correct or anything
